name: ema-cross-atr
description: ema-cross-basic with volatility-scaled exits: stop 2xATR(14), target 4xATR(14) at entry, instead of fixed 3%/8%. Motivated by the 2017 year-scale failure analysis: fixed-pct stops were noise-level in December volatility and the strategy bled stop-outs while the market rose 39%. The pct fields remain as the schema-required warmup/engine fallback.

entry_rules.note: Fast EMA(9) crosses above slow EMA(21) on this candle.
Skip entries into an already-overbought market.

exit_rules.note: Trend over: fast EMA crosses back below slow EMA.
